name: Vilanova i la Geltrú (Spain)
description: Horizontal bicolour, the upper part dark blue with a yellow castle at the centre and the lower part yellow with four red pales.
history: The flag was approved on 8 March 1999 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2857 of 29 March 1999; it is based on the arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, horizontal bicolour, the upper part dark blue with a yellow castle 8/18 of the height at the centre and the lower part yellow with four red pales.

features.role: four red pales on yellow in the lower half
